prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_FT_catboost', seasonality_champion='ONLY_CWT_catboost', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: The trend champion (ONLY_FT_catboost, corr=1.0) has poor RMSE (337.31), while the seasonality champion (ONLY_CWT_catboost, corr=0.527) is also the overall champion (RMSE=196.07). This indicates seasonality is the dominant predictive signal. With rankings_unstable (Kendall τ=0.193), high RMSE spread (2.951), and concept drift detected, robust median/trimmed_mean combinations are preferred over stacking to avoid overfitting noise. Early and late horizon specialists differ, suggesting per-horizon selection could add value.
